lead: A socket-file proof written for Linux reads as a grant bug on Windows.
body: A `/tmp/...` entry under `[capabilities.net] local` or `[capabilities.fs]` is refused there as not granted, so the refusal hides the missing transport (observed, cause not checked). Mark the program `// requires: unix`, bring the WSL mirror up with `tools/nv/driver/mirror.ts`'s `syncMirror`, build there, and run it with `/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl/debug/nvs run --config <dir>/nvs.toml`, since `--bless` refuses it on Windows.
